# Lullable

> Lullable is the low-arousal knowledge engine: an audio app that reads sleep stories and true, gently fascinating material in a warm, flat, progressively quieter voice, engineered so listeners fall asleep mid-sentence. It is the alternative to meditation apps for people whose racing minds cannot be emptied, only occupied. Not a medical device.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://getlullable.com/): what Lullable is, with an audio sample
- [The Sleep Library](https://getlullable.com/sleep/): essays on sleep and pleasantly uneventful knowledge
- [Stories](https://getlullable.com/stories/): every sleep story in the app

## Essays
- [Why do I wake up at 3am with my mind racing?](https://getlullable.com/sleep/waking-up-at-3am-mind-racing/): Waking at 3am is normal — sleep is cyclical and cortisol is already climbing. Why the racing arrives, and why reaching for your phone backfires.
- [The cognitive shuffle: the sleep trick for overthinkers](https://getlullable.com/sleep/cognitive-shuffle-method/): Imagine a series of random, unrelated things until your thinking stops making sense. The technique, the research behind it, and how to do it tonight.
- [The width of a horse: how the railway gauge was chosen](https://getlullable.com/sleep/the-standard-railway-gauge/): Most of the world's trains run 4 feet 8½ inches apart. Nobody chose that number. It was inherited from colliery carts and ratified long after it had won.
- [Why do podcasts keep me awake when I'm exhausted?](https://getlullable.com/sleep/why-do-podcasts-keep-me-awake/): Podcasts are engineered to hold attention — hooks, cliffhangers, autoplay. Why that beats your exhaustion, and what kind of audio works instead.
- [How long should it take to fall asleep?](https://getlullable.com/sleep/how-long-does-it-take-to-fall-asleep/): Ten to twenty minutes is the healthy normal — and falling asleep instantly isn't the goal. What sleep latency is, and when it's worth attention.
- [The weather at the bottom of the sea](https://getlullable.com/sleep/the-weather-at-the-bottom-of-the-sea/): There is weather at the bottom of the Mariana Trench — currents, storms of sediment, warm springs. A quiet tour of the calmest climate on Earth.
- [Two men on Ben Nevis, every hour, for 21 years](https://getlullable.com/sleep/two-men-on-ben-nevis/): From 1883 to 1904, observers on Britain's highest summit took a weather reading every single hour. A story about patience, fog, and 1.5 million numbers.
- [What are sleep stories, and do they work?](https://getlullable.com/sleep/what-are-sleep-stories/): Sleep stories are audio narratives built to be abandoned mid-listen. How they work, when they beat meditation and white noise, and what to look for.
- [What is low-arousal learning?](https://getlullable.com/sleep/what-is-low-arousal-learning/): Audio engineered to sit just below the threshold of engagement — fascinating enough to hold a racing mind, calm enough to release it into sleep.
- [Why can't I stop thinking at night?](https://getlullable.com/sleep/why-cant-i-stop-thinking-at-night/): A racing mind at bedtime usually isn't insomnia — it's an unoccupied brain. Why silence backfires for overthinkers, and what actually works.

## Stories
- [The Keeper of the Tide Clock](https://getlullable.com/stories/the-keeper-of-the-tide-clock/): 52-minute folklore sleep story. In a harbour town, one clock keeps the tides instead of the hours. Its keeper explains, gently and at length, how that works.
- [Snowfall Over the Orchard](https://getlullable.com/stories/snowfall-over-the-orchard/): 47-minute nature & weather sleep story. The first snow settles over two hundred sleeping apple trees. The orchard keeper counts rows until the counting stops mattering.
- [Cartography of Small Islands](https://getlullable.com/stories/cartography-of-small-islands/): 61-minute wandering sleep story. A mapmaker rows between seven islands that no one has bothered to name, and gives them names anyway, one per evening.
- [The Slow Train North](https://getlullable.com/stories/the-slow-train-north/): 38-minute slow fiction sleep story. A sleeper carriage, a thermos of tea, and eleven hours of dark country going by the window at the speed of a held breath.
- [Rain on the Glasshouse](https://getlullable.com/stories/rain-on-the-glasshouse/): 55-minute nature & weather sleep story. A night gardener waits out a long rain among the ferns, listening to water finding its way across a hundred panes of old glass.
- [The Lamplighter's Round](https://getlullable.com/stories/the-lamplighters-round/): 42-minute folklore sleep story. An old lamplighter walks the same nine streets he has walked for forty years, naming each lamp as he lights it. Nothing happens, slowly.
